Name: Kitron
ModernLocation: Disputed; proposed sites include Khirbet Qutteina and Tel Far
Description: A town in Zebulun's allotment whose Canaanite inhabitants Zebulun did not drive out, so they lived among them and paid tribute.
BiblicalSignificance: Kitron is one of the towns where the conquest stalled into coexistence, and the Canaanites stayed on as tributaries.
